text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Northwave renewal hits next Tue. Need a quick preflight to avoid last-minute legal/billing loops. cc @Jordi, @Priya.
Jordi (AE): Got it. CFO said they want an updated quote + PO path. I can chase vendor code.
Sam (Finance): Quick FYI — outstanding invoice INV-34577 shows pending; may block new PO until cleared. BillingBot will post details.
BillingBot: Invoice INV-34577 (Northwave) — status: pending payment. Amount: $42,800. Due: 2026-03-18.
Maya (CS): OK checklist idea (short):
  1) Confirm billing entity & vendor code
  2) Confirm payment method (wire vs cc) and lead time
  3) Confirm signer authority (who signs renewal + PO)
  4) Legal signoff on 9mo term request
  5) Prepare DocuSign with correct signer order and attach SOW
  6) Send DocSend link + copy of final quote
Priya (Legal): On the 9mo term — need to confirm there are no open compliance exceptions. If they accept 9mo we should add the clause we used for similar accounts (see template). Also confirm signatory name + title.
Jordi (AE): CFO prefers wire and will issue PO. I will confirm vendor code. CFO availability: tomorrow morning for a 10m call.
Sam (Finance): Wire timeline is 3–5bd after wire initiation. If they want immediate access we can accept CC for initial payment; ops will provision after receipt. Also: if PO is used, require signed PO + billing contact email.
Alex (Ops): DocuSign staging note — we should set signer order: (1) CFO (Purchasing), (2) Legal approver, (3) Redwood account owner. Also prepare fallback: allow delegated signer if CFO is out.
Maya (CS): Draft email for Jordi to send to CFO — feel free to paste.
Maya (CS): ```Subject: Northwave renewal — quote & PO path
Hi [CFO name],
Attaching the final quote for renewal. We can accept a PO (preferred) or wire. If PO, please include vendor code and billing entity. For wire, please use the instructions in the attached invoice. Let us know who will be signing and we can send a DocuSign for approval.
Thanks,
Jordi / Redwood
```
Jordi (AE): Pasting now. Will send and follow up after 11am PT.
Priya (Legal): If CFO signs on behalf of an affiliate, we need the affiliate legal name + tax ID in the PO.
Sam (Finance): I'll prep a one-pager with wire and card instructions and a checklist for the PO fields they must include (legal name, tax ID, billing contact, purchase order number). Will upload to the thread in a minute.
Maya (CS): Action owners: Jordi -> confirm vendor code & send CFO note; Priya -> vet 9mo template + confirm delegated signers; Sam -> upload wire/cc instructions and PO checklist; Alex -> stage DocuSign envelope and SOW.
Alex (Ops): Will stage envelope and set signing order. Tag me when quote final.
Jordi (AE): Confirmed — CFO available 10:00am PT tomorrow. I'll confirm vendor code by EOD today. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Great, please update here once vendor code confirmed. If payment clears for INV-34577 before DocuSign, we can proceed faster.
Sam (Finance): Noted — I'll follow up with AR to expedite.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — looping back after CFO call.
Jordi (AE): Quick follow-up: if they push for a mid-term change down the line, flag here and Priya can advise on amendment language.
Priya (Legal): Will do.
Maya (CS): :thumbsup:
